hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A letter is special if it occurs in the word in both lowercase and uppercase forms.

hints.title: Set Filtering
hints.text: Collect all lowercase letters in one unique set, and collect the lowercase versions of all uppercase letters in another unique set.

hints.title: Intersection Size
hints.text: Return the count of elements present in both sets.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass collecting character occurrences across 26 distinct letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single pass is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash sets or bitmasks to find shared characters cleanly.
